findings.title: cohort_clean_rates.py hardcodes the superseded 80% bar — REFUTED: it is a date-frozen evidence deliverable, and 'fixing' it would falsify the measurement the ruling cites
findings.invariant: A settled append-only ruling in DECISIONS_PWG_RU_QUALITY_BAR.md is the operative quality gate; the tool that computes the cohort verdict must apply the ruled threshold, otherwise the gate reports a verdict the owner has overturned.
findings.failure_scenario: A session re-runs `python src/pilot/cohort_clean_rates.py --out pwg_ru/h1112/cohort_clean_rates.json` (the documented invocation, cohort_clean_rates.py:25) to refresh the drain decision. verdict_for() at cohort_clean_rates.py:232-239 compares no_pwg's measured 62.0% median against BAR = 0.80 and returns BELOW_BAR; the emitted prose at cohort_clean_rates.py:319-320 states verbatim 'No cohort names a drainable lane at the 80% bar.' The lane is refrozen on a bar that MG explicitly replaced on 17-07-2026, and the freeze looks machine-derived rather than stale.
findings.affected: pwg_ru drain go/no-go decision; any session re-deriving cohort readiness
findings.evidence: DOC — DECISIONS_PWG_RU_QUALITY_BAR.md:38-47: '**Ruling (MG, 17-07-2026).** Replace the single 80% bar with **per-cohort bars.** - `no_pwg`: **60%** … **Consequences.** - Supersedes the 80% bar wherever it is referenced (H911, H255, H1149).' CODE — src/pilot/cohort_clean_rates.py:54: `BAR = 0.80`; :232 `def verdict_for(clean_rate, n, bar=BAR):`; :239 `return 'CLEARS_BAR' if clean_rate >= bar else 'BELOW_BAR'`; :319 `'No cohort names a drainable lane at the 80%% bar. no_pwg is MEASURED BELOW_BAR …'`. A repo-wide grep for a per-cohort bar table (`COHORT_BAR|per_cohort_bars|BAR = 0`) returns only this 0.80 and an unrelated `rv_wordlevel_gold.PRECISION_BAR = 0.85`, so the 60% figure is implemented nowhere. The committed machine-readable artifact carries the superseded state too: pwg_ru/h1112/cohort_clean_rates.json holds `"bar": 0.8` with no_pwg `"verdict": "BELOW_BAR"`.
findings.existing_test_gap: window_selftest.py's only consumer of this module is test coverage of `assert_h_reconstructed_regression` (window_selftest.py:7997-8008, the D-1 worklist guard). Nothing asserts the bar value, and nothing cross-checks cohort_clean_rates against DECISIONS_PWG_RU_QUALITY_BAR.md, so the superseded threshold is invisible to CI.
findings.fix_boundary: src/pilot/cohort_clean_rates.py (BAR → a per-cohort map with no_pwg=0.60 and None for root_upasarga/nominal, plus the :319 prose), then regenerate pwg_ru/h1112/cohort_clean_rates.json; optionally a selftest pinning the map against the D1 ruling.

corrections: Two details to correct. (1) The documented invocation cannot be re-run from an isolated worktree at all: verb_worklist.PREVERB resolves to RT/../../PWG, which is C:/Users/user/Documents/PWG from the h2889 worktree and does not exist, so main() dies with FileNotFoundError at verb_worklist.py:44 before ever reaching verdict_for. The scenario requires the MAIN checkout (where GitHub/PWG/verbs01/pwg_preverb1.txt does exist — I verified the file and patched PREVERB to it to reproduce). (2) Severity should be P2, not P1: no automated gate reads the emitted verdict/bar (the only wired consumer is the h_reconstructed regression guard), and D1 itself keeps the lane human-blocked on GTD:579 provisioning regardless of the quality gate, so the harm is a stale machine-looking verdict misleading a decision, not an automated wrong drain. Worth adding to the fix boundary: 'measured': '2026-07-17' at cohort_clean_rates.py:245 is also hardcoded, so any regeneration falsely re-stamps the July measurement date.

Right that BAR = 0.80 contradicts D1's 60% no_pwg bar; wrong that this is a gate defect, and wrong in its fix. cohort_clean_rates.py regenerates a date-frozen evidence deliverable (H1149/H1112, stamped 17-07-2026 in both JSON and MD) that D1 quotes verbatim as its Context; lowering BAR to 0.60 and regenerating pwg_ru/h1112/cohort_clean_rates.json would falsify the measurement that justified the ruling. The only defensible residue is documentation hygiene, at P3: add a "superseded by D1 (DECISIONS_PWG_RU_QUALITY_BAR.md) — the 80% bar shown here was replaced with per-cohort bars on 17-07-2026" banner to pwg_ru/h1112/H1112_COHORT_CLEAN_RATES_2026-07-17.md (whose regenerated body still self-declares "this report gates every pwg_ru drain in the repo" with "**Bar:** 80%"), and optionally a `superseded_by` key in the JSON — leaving BAR, the verdicts and the numbers untouched. Separately noted while checking, not part of this finding: docs/VERIFICATION_…_UNFREEZE.md:2.1's `assert r['cohorts']['no_pwg']['rows'] == 6009` already fails against the committed artifact's 5696 (it is the rows_including_h_reconstructed figure).

findings.lead_adjudication: Reproduction is right on every fact and still lands on the wrong conclusion, which is exactly what the correctness lens is for. Yes: D1 rules per-cohort bars (no_pwg 60%) and says it 'supersedes the 80% bar wherever it is referenced'; the decisions file is append-only so D1 is not itself reversed; cohort_clean_rates.py:54 is still BAR = 0.80; both live call sites pass no override; and the module really does compute no_pwg 0.62 -> BELOW_BAR where D1's bar gives CLEARS_BAR. But the script is not a gate. It hardcodes 'measured': '2026-07-17', its MD writer hardcodes the 17-07-2026 dateline and the literal '(< 80% bar)' prose, main() SystemExits unless it finds exactly 468 h_reconstructed rows and 14 heads, and its own docstring forbids re-running for a better number ('report what the frozen evidence says and stop'). It regenerates the H1112/H1149 evidence artifact that D1's own Context quotes verbatim -- so the finding's proposed fix, lowering BAR and regenerating the JSON, would rewrite the measurement that justified the ruling. Nothing reads the artifact's bar or verdict: window_selftest asserts only that the verdict is one of three strings, never its value, and that same block's `assert no_pwg['rows'] == 6009` already fails against the committed 5696, proving it is dead 17-07 acceptance scaffolding. Ruling: REFUTED, preserved. Residue at P3, doc hygiene only: put a supersede banner on H1112_COHORT_CLEAN_RATES_2026-07-17.md naming D1, so a reader who lands on the frozen artifact is not misled by its '< 80% bar' prose.

findings.title: Ruling D2 requires a machine-preview caveat on every citation of the lane and the export layer grades machine-preview 'non-citable'; CITATION.cff carries no such caveat
findings.invariant: If the ruled quality claim is 'machine-preview, explicitly not production-grade' and the export layer marks that grade non-citable, the repo's own citation surfaces must carry the caveat — otherwise the repo publishes a citation for material it internally classifies as non-citable.
findings.failure_scenario: A paper or dataset aggregator picks up CITATION.cff and cites 'pwg_ru: a Russian edition of the Sanskrit-German Petersburg Dictionary … produced by corpus-attested sense harvesting … Every sense carries source and role provenance; the edition exports to OntoLex-Lemon and TEI Lex-0' as a released dataset. Nothing in that record says the content is machine-preview at a 60%-band audit-clean rate, so the D2 consequence 'Any paper citing the pwg_ru lane must carry the machine-preview caveat' silently fails at exactly the surface built for citation.
